notes.message: 'clerk' comes from another service; its owner binds the select, the filter and every path under the alias.

A reference of 'clerk' that resolves to nothing leaves the alias null; only an owner that fails is reported (onMissing null, strict); ambiguous, not_found, invalid_key, owner_unanswered lose data and refuse under strict. A key more than one record holds is always reported (RESOLVE_AMBIGUOUS).
'clerk' is joined after the page is taken, for the page's rows only.
After an unwind or a group the rows page by offset, up to offset 5000; rows written between two pages may repeat or be skipped.
